visual_strategy: one small shot approximately one image
use UI inserts only when the screen state itself is the story event
avoid architecture diagrams and explanatory cards
mechanism reveal remains embodied by character action

shots.narration_span: 假设我今天真开了家小店，我最先想辞掉的工作，大概就是退款。
shots.visual_state: IP sits behind a small shop admin desk buried in refund notifications, staring at the screen as if this is the job he most wants to escape.
shots.action: IP leans toward a monitor packed with refund requests, hand hovering over mouse.
shots.composition: medium-wide, desk and monitor both visible
shots.image_intent: Immediate human situation: small-business owner overwhelmed by repetitive refund work.
acceptance_criteria: scene feels lived-in rather than corporate stock

shots.narration_span: 查订单，看看过没过期限，再看东西发没发，符合条件就退，不符合就解释。
shots.visual_state: Multiple small admin windows surround the IP while his hand repeats the same click-check-click rhythm.
shots.action: IP rapidly checks order status, shipping state, and refund buttons across overlapping windows.
shots.composition: medium shot with screen layers occupying foreground edges
shots.image_intent: Make repetitive decision labor concrete without showing a text checklist.

shots.narration_span: 我是一个长着人脸的“确认”按钮。
shots.visual_state: IP slumps behind a comically oversized physical confirmation button placed where the keyboard should be.
shots.action: IP presses the oversized confirm button with deadpan resignation.
shots.image_intent: Turn the recurring verbal joke into a visual motif.
visual_forbidden: no literal transformation of IP into a machine

shots.narration_span: 所以我第一反应当然是：这不正适合交给 AI 吗？
shots.visual_state: IP turns from the refund screen toward the AI partner with sudden confidence.
shots.action: IP swivels laptop toward AI partner and gestures at the refund pile.
shots.image_intent: The story moves because the character chooses delegation.

shots.narration_span: 我把订单资料和退款规则全丢给它：“今天这些退款，你帮我处理掉。”
shots.visual_state: IP physically slides a stack of order sheets and rule sheets toward AI partner.
shots.action: IP pushes folders across desk; AI partner receives them.
shots.image_intent: Use physical handoff instead of abstract data transfer.
shots.subtitle_intent: 今天这些退款，你帮我处理掉。

shots.narration_span: 十秒以后，它给了我一份特别完整的《退款处理方案》。
shots.visual_state: AI partner proudly hands back a neat multi-page plan instead of doing the work.
shots.action: AI partner presents a thick stapled plan to IP.
shots.image_intent: The failure is visible as a returned document, not explained by a slide.
acceptance_criteria: audience immediately understands AI returned advice rather than execution

shots.narration_span: 最后还贴心地提醒我：“注意保持礼貌沟通。”
shots.visual_state: Close insert on the last line of the plan while IP's finger stops on the polite-reminder line.
shots.action: IP points at the final reminder line.
shots.expression: not visible / implied through hand pause
shots.composition: insert close-up of paper and finger
shots.image_intent: Let the document itself deliver the joke.
acceptance_criteria: only the necessary phrase is readable

shots.narration_span: 我从头看了一遍，又看了一眼第四步。“回复客户。” 嗯。
shots.visual_state: IP holds the plan, eyes fixed on the fourth line, then gives a tiny deadpan look.
shots.action: IP lowers the paper slightly after rereading the last step.
shots.image_intent: Preserve the '嗯' as visual subtext; no explanatory caption.
acceptance_criteria: reaction is readable without exaggerated cartoon anger

shots.narration_span: 它非常认真地把我的工作拆成四份，然后完整退货给我了。
shots.visual_state: AI partner slides the same four-part work stack back across the desk like a returned parcel.
shots.action: AI partner pushes a parcel-like bundle labeled with the work back toward IP.
shots.image_intent: Visualize '退货给我' as a recurring physical joke.

shots.narration_span: “你不是都知道下一步该干什么吗？” “那订单、退款、邮箱，一起给你。”
shots.visual_state: IP opens access to three concrete tools in front of AI partner.
shots.action: IP places three clearly different tool objects/interfaces—orders, refund control, mail—within AI partner's reach.
shots.image_intent: Show increased operational access as physical availability, not system architecture.

shots.narration_span: 第一封进来，查订单，符合规则，退了，发邮件。
shots.visual_state: AI partner independently checks an order and completes a refund while IP does nothing.
shots.action: AI partner operates order screen; IP sits back.
shots.image_intent: First proof that delegation now genuinely works.

shots.narration_span: 第二封，不符合，它自己解释。第三封，又处理完了。
shots.visual_state: AI partner processes a decline reply, then another completed request while IP's hands stay off the controls.
shots.action: AI partner alternates between email reply and refund completion; IP watches from side.
shots.image_intent: Compress repeated success into one meaningful changed state rather than separate identical shots.
acceptance_criteria: progress is visible without redundant images

shots.narration_span: 我把电脑声音开着。叮一声，少点一次鼠标。再叮一声，又少点一次。
shots.visual_state: IP leans back as notification sound indicators appear while his mouse hand stays idle.
shots.action: IP removes hand from mouse; AI continues working in background.
shots.composition: medium shot, idle mouse prominent foreground
shots.image_intent: Make the sensory 'ding' and reduced clicking visual.

shots.narration_span: 到第三声的时候，我已经开始查楼下哪家咖啡下午三点还营业。
shots.visual_state: IP casually searches for a cafe while AI works behind him.
shots.action: IP looks at a cafe map/list on phone, half turned away from work.
shots.image_intent: Concrete human detail signals relief better than an emotion label.

shots.narration_span: 然后屏幕上跳出来一条记录。金额大得让我瞬间坐直。
shots.visual_state: A large refund amount suddenly appears on the monitor; IP snaps upright.
shots.action: IP straightens sharply toward screen.
shots.composition: over-shoulder with large amount visible but no fake brand UI
shots.image_intent: The visual state changes from leisure to danger in one beat.

shots.narration_span: 订单备注还拉了老长一串：客户说没收到，物流显示签收，客服又写着“已补发”，下面还有两轮来回沟通。
shots.visual_state: Close insert shows a tangled order record with conflicting status markers and long conversation history.
shots.action: Static UI insert of conflicting order facts.
shots.image_intent: Show why this case is genuinely ambiguous without a narrator diagram.
visual_forbidden: no huge paragraphs of readable text
acceptance_criteria: conflict is visually legible through a few concise status elements

shots.narration_span: 系统显示：已退款。
shots.visual_state: Minimal screen state: completed refund status occupies the focal area.
shots.action: System state is already final.
shots.image_intent: Let the system state itself be the punch.
acceptance_criteria: '已退款' is the dominant readable state

shots.narration_span: 我盯着那三个字。“……谁让你点确认了？”
shots.visual_state: IP stares frozen at screen, then turns toward AI partner.
shots.action: IP slowly turns from screen to AI partner.
shots.composition: medium close-up with AI partner edge-of-frame
shots.image_intent: The line performs control reclamation; visual holds the subtext.
acceptance_criteria: tension is readable through gaze and turn

shots.narration_span: 刚才还觉得它会自己决定特别省事，现在我只想把它的手从鼠标上拿开。
shots.visual_state: IP physically pulls the mouse/control back toward himself from AI partner.
shots.action: IP slides mouse/control device away from AI partner.
shots.composition: hands and faces in medium shot
shots.image_intent: Turn abstract permission rollback into a concrete action.

shots.narration_span: 于是我当场改规则：以后所有退款，都先问我。听起来非常安全。
shots.visual_state: IP confidently places a visible 'ask me first' checkpoint between AI partner and refund button.
shots.action: IP inserts a physical approval stamp/card in front of the refund control.
shots.image_intent: Represent universal approval as a tangible bottleneck object.

shots.narration_span: 第二天早上，我打开电脑，二十多个确认窗口整整齐齐排在那里。
shots.visual_state: Morning desk; monitor flooded with many approval popups.
shots.action: IP opens laptop and freezes at the wall of approval prompts.
shots.composition: wide enough to show screen flood and body reaction
shots.image_intent: The bottleneck consequence becomes visible instantly.
acceptance_criteria: many confirmations are obvious without textual overload

shots.narration_span: 一个个像上课举手。“这笔能退吗？”“这笔呢？”“这个呢？”“这个可以吗？”
shots.visual_state: Confirmation windows are staged like small raised hands while IP faces them like an exhausted teacher.
shots.action: IP sits before a row of popup 'hands'.
shots.image_intent: Continue the IP's everyday metaphor without switching to infographic mode.
visual_forbidden: no literal classroom scene replacing the shop entirely
acceptance_criteria: metaphor reads while shop context stays visible

shots.narration_span: 昨天订单是我自己查。今天它什么都查完了。最后只把一样东西还给我——鼠标。
shots.visual_state: AI partner has neatly completed all research; at the edge of frame a single mouse is pushed back to IP.
shots.action: AI partner slides only the mouse toward IP.
shots.composition: low desk close-up emphasizing mouse with both characters blurred/secondary
shots.image_intent: Land the word '鼠标' as a visual object, not a caption.
visual_forbidden: no giant word MOUSE on screen
acceptance_criteria: mouse is unmistakably the final returned item

shots.narration_span: 很好。我成功从客服升级成了 AI 的审批插件。
shots.visual_state: IP sits plugged metaphorically between AI partner and refund control like a human approval dongle.
shots.action: IP reluctantly stamps/approves while AI queues cases.
shots.image_intent: Visualize '审批插件' without turning the character into a literal machine.
visual_forbidden: no literal USB inserted into body

shots.narration_span: 我把那二十多个窗口关掉，又重新打开退款规则。
shots.visual_state: IP closes the flood of popups and places a blank rule sheet beside the controls.
shots.action: IP sweeps popups away and starts rewriting rules.
shots.image_intent: Show active correction rather than narrator summary.

shots.narration_span: 59 块，昨天下单，还没发货——它自己退。
shots.visual_state: Simple low-value order with clear unshipped status passes automatically through AI partner.
shots.action: AI partner approves a clearly simple refund without stopping.
shots.image_intent: Concrete example first; no abstract rule labels.

shots.narration_span: 2999 块，备注扯了三页，钱出去还不好追回——停。
shots.visual_state: Large ambiguous refund reaches a physical stop marker before execution.
shots.action: AI partner's hand/control pauses before refund while a stop state appears.
shots.image_intent: Show the boundary as an action stop, not a framework slide.

shots.narration_span: 规则互相打架——停。做完很难撤回来——也停。
shots.visual_state: Two different difficult cases queue and both halt before the final control.
shots.action: AI partner pauses at the same handoff point for two visibly different cases.
shots.composition: medium shot with two case cards/props
shots.image_intent: Use repetition as semantic rhythm while keeping a character actor on screen.
acceptance_criteria: two different reasons for stopping are visible

shots.narration_span: 几天后，又来了一笔麻烦退款。这次它没碰钱。
shots.visual_state: A new complex refund appears; AI partner deliberately keeps hands away from the refund control.
shots.action: AI partner reviews the case but stops before the money action.
shots.image_intent: Show restraint as an active choice.
visual_forbidden: no warning triangle as the main subject
acceptance_criteria: audience sees that execution has intentionally paused

shots.narration_span: 它把订单、规则和之前的沟通记录全整理好，只弹出来一句：“这笔超出自动处理范围，需要你确认。”
shots.visual_state: AI partner lays out a concise evidence bundle and a single confirmation request to IP.
shots.action: AI partner presents organized case materials without clicking refund.
shots.image_intent: The new operating rule is proven by behavior.
shots.subtitle_intent: 这笔超出自动处理范围，需要你确认。
acceptance_criteria: evidence bundle and handoff are both visible

shots.narration_span: 我盯着那个窗口看了两秒。第一次觉得 AI 来烦我，也不是什么坏事。
shots.visual_state: IP looks at the single confirmation window, shoulders relaxed rather than annoyed.
shots.action: IP pauses, then gives a small accepting nod.
shots.image_intent: Contrast with the earlier wall of approval windows.

shots.narration_span: 后来我才知道，所谓 Agent，关键也不只是会不会聊天、会不会接几个工具。
shots.visual_state: Same shop scene; AI partner stands at the working desk with the real tools already used throughout the story.
shots.action: IP looks across the actual workflow tools already present; no new diagram appears.
shots.image_intent: Reveal the term only after the audience has seen the behavior; reuse story objects.
acceptance_criteria: term reveal stays grounded in existing story environment

shots.narration_span: 真正变化的是，我开始把“下一步做什么”这件事交给它。它可以自己往前走。
shots.visual_state: AI partner independently moves a case through several real desk stations while IP remains seated back.
shots.action: AI partner moves from order check to reply to refund decision point without prompting.
shots.composition: wide lateral shot showing a short physical workflow path
shots.image_intent: Embodied workflow control instead of boxes/arrows.
acceptance_criteria: autonomous next-step choice is shown through movement/action

shots.narration_span: 但到了某些地方，它得知道停。
shots.visual_state: AI partner stops at the same approval boundary before a high-stakes control and looks to IP.
shots.action: AI partner physically stops and turns toward IP before final action.
shots.expression: AI neutral/attentive; IP ready to decide
shots.image_intent: One action expresses the core viewpoint.
visual_forbidden: no red stop-sign graphic as substitute for character action
acceptance_criteria: handoff is the central visible event

shots.narration_span: 所以现在我看一个 Agent，第一眼已经不是它接了多少工具。
shots.visual_state: A pile of extra tool icons/interfaces sits ignored at the edge while IP watches the handoff behavior instead.
shots.action: IP turns attention away from extra tool cards toward AI partner's stop-and-ask behavior.
shots.image_intent: Visually deprioritize tool count without creating a comparison slide.
visual_forbidden: no split-screen 'more tools vs less tools' infographic

shots.narration_span: 我只看一件事——它知不知道，什么时候该自己往前走。以及什么时候，该回来敲门。
shots.visual_state: AI partner stands at a half-open doorway between the work area and IP, one hand ready to continue, the other lightly knocking before crossing the boundary.
shots.action: AI partner pauses and knocks; IP looks up to receive the decision.
shots.composition: medium-wide, doorway/threshold framed naturally within shop world
shots.image_intent: Pay off the '回来敲门' metaphor as a real boundary action, not a slogan card.
acceptance_criteria: door/threshold metaphor feels native to story
